doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: How he found Stanley Clarke and Lenny White
summary: Fuller heard Clarke with Horace Silver, then discusses Silver's group with Clifford Jordan.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well, within that, what was the conversation internally, with a George and with a Stanley and with a Lenny?
They were young kids; they were young guys. As a matter of fact, I got half airfares because Stanley was from Philadelphia and he was playing with the Gene Normandy Youth Orchestra classically.

Well, he had done a gig with Horace Silver who I saw in the club. I fell in love with him. He was commuting from… Then, when Art Farmer left Horace Silver’s, Horace used to me because I knew his music, me and Clifford Jordan. Clifford Jordan and I were the front line.
So, that's how you met him. How did you meet Lenny White?
